name: stats
js: (() => { const C = window.CITY, s = C.parkedStats, p = C.patioStats || {}; const q = new URLSearchParams(location.search); const app = window.__CITY_APP; const out = { parked: s && { enabled: s.enabled, tier: s.tier, cap: s.cap, kept: s.kept, laneDropped: s.laneDropped, laneDroppedBy: s.laneDroppedBy, laneDrops: s.laneDrops, patioDropped: s.patioDropped, colliders: s.colliders, ms: s.ms, decodeMs: s.decodeMs, kinds: s.kinds, cats: s.cats, source: s.source && { stalls: s.source.stalls, cars: s.source.cars } }, patios: { layout: p.layout, fingerprint: p.fingerprint, check: p.check, placed: p.placed, laneConflicts: p.laneConflicts && p.laneConflicts.length }, q: location.search }; console.log('[ride-check] parked ' + JSON.stringify(out)); if (q.get('parked') !== '0') { if (!s || !s.enabled || s.kept < 3000) throw new Error('Parked cars missing: ' + JSON.stringify(out.parked)); if (s.colliders !== s.kept) throw new Error('A parked car without its collider'); if (s.laneDropped > s.kept * 0.06) throw new Error('Too many parked cars in the built lanes: ' + s.laneDropped); } if (p.fingerprint && !p.fingerprint.ok) throw new Error('The prebuilt patio layout is stale: ' + JSON.stringify(p.fingerprint)); if (q.get('patios') === 'check' && !(p.check && p.check.identical)) throw new Error('The prebuilt patio layout is not the runtime algorithm\'s: ' + JSON.stringify(p.check)); return out; })()

name: euclid-street
js: (() => { window.__CITY_APP.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-2057.6, 1.65, -1766], look: [-2052.4, 1.0, -1700], fov: 55 }); const s = window.CITY.parkedStats; console.log('[ride-check] euclid ' + JSON.stringify({ near: s && s.near, far: s && s.far })); })()
